# Uthereal Cortex SDK

> Public TypeScript SDK for integrating Uthereal Cortex with your application.

- [Start here](https://github.com/Uthereal-Labs/Uthereal-Cortex-SDK/blob/v1.1.0-rc.0/README.md)
- [Integration guide](https://github.com/Uthereal-Labs/Uthereal-Cortex-SDK/blob/v1.1.0-rc.0/INTEGRATING.md): auth, storage, Ask, RAG, citations and PDFs
- [Public API contract](https://github.com/Uthereal-Labs/Uthereal-Cortex-SDK/blob/v1.1.0-rc.0/openapi.json)
- [Synthetic fixtures](https://github.com/Uthereal-Labs/Uthereal-Cortex-SDK/tree/v1.1.0-rc.0/examples): verify without credentials

Install @uthereal-sdk/cortex@1.1.0-rc.0. Use /server on the server and /browser in
the frontend; /react and Supabase adapters have optional peers. Preserve the host
application’s instructions. Keep Cortex keys in server secrets. A pinned GitHub
source-copy integration remains supported.
